description: The function constructs vec from caller-controlled text and unconditionally reads vec[2] without verifying that at least three elements were parsed. The upstream command dispatcher invokes this function when recvStr contains the substring "SP_daemon -editor", but that condition does not guarantee three space-delimited tokens. A request such as "SP_daemon -editor" produces only two vector elements, so vec[2] is out of bounds. std::vector::operator[] performs no bounds check, making the access undefined behavior and plausibly causing a service crash or denial of service.
